name: Charminar
description: Iconic 1591 monument with four minarets built by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah; climb to the first floor for views of Laad Bazaar.

name: Mecca Masjid
description: One of India's largest mosques, beside Charminar. Visitors should avoid prayer times and dress modestly.

name: Laad Bazaar
description: Historic bangle market (Choodi Bazaar) running west from Charminar; famous for lacquer bangles and pearls.

name: Chowmahalla Palace
description: Seat of the Asaf Jahi Nizams with four palaces, a clock tower and a vintage car collection.

name: Bhagyalakshmi Temple
description: Small Hindu temple at the base of Charminar's south-east minaret.

name: Badshahi Ashurkhana
description: 1594 royal mourning hall known for its Persian tile mosaics; most crowded during Muharram.

name: Pathergatti Shopping Street
description: Stone-arcaded street north of Charminar for pearls, attar, textiles and Irani chai stops.

name: Gulzar Houz
description: Historic fountain square between Charminar and Char Kaman arches.

name: Salar Jung Museum
description: One of India's largest one-man collections: the Veiled Rebecca, the musical clock (chimes on the hour) and Mughal jade.

name: Nizam's Museum (Purani Haveli)
description: Gifts presented to the seventh Nizam, including a silver jubilee collection and the world's longest wardrobe.

name: Nehru Zoological Park
description: Large zoo with lion safari and nocturnal house; battery vehicles available inside.

name: Sudha Cars Museum
description: Quirky handmade cars shaped like burgers, cricket bats and handbags.

name: Paigah Tombs
description: Marble tombs of the Paigah nobility with exquisite lattice and stucco work; quiet and rarely crowded.

name: Golconda Fort
description: Qutb Shahi citadel famous for its acoustics (a clap at the gate is heard at the top) and the Bala Hissar climb.

name: Qutb Shahi Tombs
description: Restored necropolis of the seven Qutb Shahi rulers, with domed tombs, step wells and gardens.

name: Taramati Baradari
description: Hilltop pavilion linked to the legend of the court singer Taramati; good for sunset views.

name: Birla Mandir
description: White marble Venkateswara temple on Naubath Pahad; closed to visitors 12:00-14:00; phones and cameras not allowed inside.

name: Birla Planetarium and Science Museum
description: Planetarium shows and a dinosaur fossil gallery next to Birla Mandir.

name: Telangana State Archaeology Museum
description: Oldest museum in the state with an Egyptian mummy and Buddhist sculptures, in the Public Gardens.

name: Hussain Sagar Lake and Buddha Statue
description: Heart-shaped lake with a 16 m monolithic Buddha statue; ticket covers the boat ride from Lumbini Park.

name: Lumbini Park
description: Lakeside park with musical fountain and the jetty for boats to the Buddha statue.

name: NTR Gardens
description: Family garden with toy train and rides on the banks of Hussain Sagar.

name: Sanjeevaiah Park
description: Large lakeside park with the national flag post and rose garden.

name: Snow World
description: Indoor snow park on Lower Tank Bund; jackets and boots provided.

name: Tank Bund Promenade
description: Lake-front road lined with statues of Telugu luminaries; car-free 'Sunday Funday' evenings.

name: Secunderabad Clock Tower
description: 1897 clock tower in a small garden in the twin city of Secunderabad.

name: Spanish Mosque
description: Moorish-style mosque inspired by the Cordoba mosque; visits on request outside prayer times.

name: Jagannath Temple
description: Sandstone temple modelled on Puri's Jagannath temple; beautiful when lit in the evening.

name: Peddamma Temple
description: Popular temple to the mother goddess; very busy during Bonalu festival.

name: KBR National Park
description: Urban forest with a 6 km walking loop, peacocks and the Chiran Palace.

name: State Gallery of Art
description: Contemporary and folk art exhibitions in Kavuri Hills.

name: Shilparamam
description: Arts and crafts village with artisans from across India and evening cultural performances.

name: Durgam Cheruvu Cable Bridge
description: Lit cable-stayed bridge over the 'Secret Lake'; best after 19:00.

name: Botanical Garden (Kotla Vijayabhaskara Reddy)
description: Themed gardens and a nature trail in Kondapur.

name: Inorbit Mall
description: Large mall beside Durgam Cheruvu with food court and multiplex.

name: Ramoji Film City
description: One of the world's largest film studio complexes; plan a full day, about 30 km from the city.

name: Statue of Equality
description: 216-foot seated statue of Ramanujacharya at Muchintal; laser show in the evening.

name: British Residency
description: 1803 Palladian mansion, now part of Osmania University Women's College; restored by WMF.

name: Mozamjahi Market
description: Restored 1935 stone market famous for fruit stalls and the Famous Ice Cream shop.

name: Nampally Exhibition Grounds
description: Venue of Numaish, the All India Industrial Exhibition, every January to mid-February.

name: Lamakaan Cultural Space
description: Open cultural space with free events, plays and the famous Irani chai and samosa canteen.

name: Ravindra Bharathi Auditorium
description: State auditorium hosting classical music, dance and theatre.

name: Chiran Fort Club Heritage Walk
description: Guided morning heritage walk around the Chiran palace precinct (weekends best).

name: Moula Ali Dargah
description: Hilltop shrine reached by about 500 steps; panoramic city views.

name: Ocean Park
description: Water park near Gandipet; carry swimwear.
